meta.name: auth-implementation-patterns
meta.description: Master authentication and authorization patterns including JWT, OAuth2, session management, and RBAC to build secure, scalable access control systems. Use when implementing auth systems, securing APIs, or debugging security issues.

copy.tagline: 为应用加上登录认证和权限校验,防止未授权访问
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果正在开发应用并需要实现用户登录和权限管理
copy.tagline_en: Add login and permission checks to your app to block unauthorized access
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are building an app and need to add user login and permission management

howto.what: Claude 会按认证与授权分离的思路指导实现：覆盖会话登录、JWT 令牌、OAuth2/OpenID Connect 等认证方式，以及 RBAC 权限控制；同时会提醒对密码哈希存储、设置短期令牌、httpOnly Cookie 等安全要点。
howto.when: 当你要求实现认证系统、保护 API 或排查与授权相关的安全问题时触发。

say.text: 帮我用 JWT 做一个用户登录和接口鉴权方案。
say.note: 它会给出 JWT 签发、校验和过期策略。

say.text: 给后端 API 接入 OAuth2，支持 Google 第三方登录。
say.note: 它会讲解授权码流程和回调处理。

say.text: 检查我的 Session 认证是否存在 CSRF 漏洞。
say.note: 它会对照最佳实践逐条排查。

howto.what_en: Claude guides you through authentication vs authorization: session-based login, JWT tokens, OAuth2/OpenID Connect, RBAC. It also enforces security essentials like password hashing, short-lived tokens, httpOnly cookies, server-side validation.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to implement an authentication system, secure an API, or debug security/auth issues.

say_en.text: Help me build JWT-based login and API authorization.
say_en.note: It will walk through token issuance and validation.

say_en.text: Add OAuth2 to my backend with Google social login.
say_en.note: It explains the authorization code flow and callbacks.

say_en.text: Review my session-based auth for CSRF risks.
say_en.note: It checks against the listed best practices.
